claims.statement: The r26 C4/C5 deletion-coefficient carriers and r27 G1 first-descent/order-bound carriers can support a conditional proof of the primary first-interior aggregate, provided explicit finite-set coefficient/deletion, Nat/Int rank, and Nat.find predicate equalities are proved; r26's top-rank residual theorem does not itself transfer. The proposed eligible-tree alpha>=7 and bipartite tagged-shadow inequalities would compose without residuality to prove the primary, but those auxiliary claims and the carrier formalization remain open, so the primary is unresolved.
claims.scope: Ordinary finite connected trees with integer p=alpha(T)-2 and x(T)+2<=p; semantic transport between the primary, pinned r26 C4/C5 definitions, and r27 LA4 Nat.find G1 first-descent/forest bound, plus the conditional high-tail tagged-shadow composition. No claim on broader ranks, forests as primary targets, RTree, or the r26 residual top-rank face.
claims.reason: The counting and indexing transport is plausible but requires explicit formal equality lemmas; LA2's Nat.sInf carrier cannot be treated as definitional equality with LA4's Nat.find carrier. Even after transport, the OPEN alpha>=7 and tagged-shadow statements are the missing mathematical inputs. The high-tail arithmetic itself is correctly aligned at k=p-1, and every leaf tag/multiplicity can be retained. Exact larger-target evidence and inherited scope fences do not prove a universal claim.

limitations: No Lean build was run, as assigned.
The registered tagged-shadow and alpha-at-least-seven auxiliaries remain unproved proposals.
Only one fresh larger exact tree was checked; no unbounded search was performed.
No primary counterexample or universal proof was established.
